summary.text: Dillon Fillion is the Republican candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 81, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Daniel Gosa is also running.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Dillon Fillion was born in Davenport, Iowa, on May 9, 2004, and graduated from Bettendorf High School in 2023.
He enrolled at Scott Community College in August 2023 to pursue an associate degree in criminal justice.
Fillion has volunteered for political campaigns, including U.S. Representative Mariannette Miller-Meeks' re-election campaign and Scott Webster's state Senate campaign.
He also worked as a field operator for Donald Trump's campaign in Iowa and served as a caucus captain in his precinct.
